messages:
micah: regen created a semver bump in go-sdk on master and CI is red — looks like some optional fields turned into pointers. not sure if this was intended. cc @elaine @kevin

devex-bot: regen-diff-detect: go/sdk v1.4.2 -> v1.5.0 detected: 3 exported symbol changes, 2 struct fields changed from value -> pointer. see: https://ci/reports/regen/1912299999

elaine: ugh. is this from an openapi change or did typegen flip a default? any failing tests pasted?

micah: failing test snippet:
```
# github.com/redwood/go-sdk/v1/client
./session_types.go:42:12: cannot use session.Token (type *string) as type string in assignment
FAIL    github.com/redwood/go-sdk/v1/client  0.742s
```
path: go/sdk/gen/session_types.go

kevin: i think the generator started applying `--prefer-pointers` after the last tools bump. i have a branch with a revert candidate: https://github.com/redwood/tools/compare/fix-pointer-default

shayna: we should avoid a semver minor for a generator flag switch that alters public signatures unless there's a real behavior change. patch release or shim would be nicer. also changelog entry is missing for this change :eyes: 

elaine: propose hotfix plan: 1) revert typegen default to previous behavior (no global prefer-pointers) 2) cut v1.5.1 as patch that preserves public types 3) run regen CI with `TYPEGEN_STABLE_API=1` to detect exported-symbol diffs before merge. I'll open PRs for 1 and 2.

micah: sounds good. i'll open DP ticket and add a CI check to fail on exported symbol diffs (DP-421). i'll also pin the tools version in the go-sdk repo until we stabilize. i'll send the PR in ~30m. :thumbsup:

devex-bot: ci-bot: PR #1234 merged into main (tools revert). regen pipeline scheduled to re-run; watch: https://ci/reports/regen/1912300001

kevin: after we unstick CI, let's add an automated lint that flags generated public API diffs and a small checklist in devex/release.md to remind SDK owners to run `make regen-check` before bumping tools.

shayna: agreed — and add a changelog template snippet for generator-introduced API changes so release notes don't miss it.

micah: thanks all — will follow up once the rerun is green.
